name: Heavy Dragon 15
author: barisdogansutcu
description: Gray button that responds while pressed down with a smooth transition.
howItWorks: While pressed, box-shadow becomes inset -1px -1px #fff, inset 1px 1px #292929, inset -2px -2px #ffffff, inset 2px 2px #9e9e9e.
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Heavy Dragon 15</title>
<style>
/* Heavy Dragon 15 by barisdogansutcu — https://uiverse.io/barisdogansutcu/heavy-dragon-15 */
button {
  font-family: inherit;
  border: none;
  outline: 1px dotted rgb(37, 37, 37);
  outline-offset: -4px;
  background: hsl(0deg 0% 75%);
  box-shadow: inset -1px -1px #292929, inset 1px 1px #fff, inset -2px -2px rgb(158, 158, 158), inset 2px 2px #ffffff;
  font-size: 14px;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 2px;
  padding: 5px 30px;
}

button:active {
  box-shadow: inset -1px -1px #fff, inset 1px 1px #292929, inset -2px -2px #ffffff, inset 2px 2px rgb(158, 158, 158);
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button>
    ok
</button>

</body>
</html>
